package org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.games.sudoku
  • Class
    Description
    Sudoku3D
    A native 3D sudoku.
    SudokuModel
    Pure sudoku engine: generates a random full grid, digs a unique-solution puzzle out of it, and tracks the working grid the player edits.
    SudokuPanel
    The 2D/Swing counterpart of the native-3D Sudoku3D.

    The sudoku board, rasterised into a single live texture with the same ImageComponent2D.set recipe as AgendaGrid / MailView.
    SudokuView.CellListener
